scope: Cross-component queued-turn reorder with Datly 1.0 generated writers
composition: Canonical turn_queue reader verifies both queued rows belong to the requested conversation and match the expected sequences.
Generated turn writer patches both turn.queue_seq values.
Generated turn_queue writer patches both queue sequence values.
The custom parent starts one managed transaction before reading and invokes both writers through the typed ComponentInvoker. It owns no SQL or database handle.
cases: managed commit changes turn and queue together
zero sequence is a supplied expected value
late queue failure rolls back prior turn writes
stale sequence is rejected before mutation
legacy_comparison: The success and late-failure cases execute the original SDK0 caller's turn-batch plus two independent queue patches in the isolated legacy probe. SDK0 leaves turn and first queue changes after the second queue patch fails; SDK1 rolls back both tables.
host_linkage: The linked Datly host supplies this private holder and its named typed factory registry. The E2E runtime builds the artifact through that exported registry, then registers both generated writers and reader. A separate test confirms the production route tag resolves as internal.
